subject: Ops handshake — confirm timeblock for technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@bluearcmed.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@bluearcmed.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery — technical deep-dive request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the discovery yesterday — the team found the run-of-show helpful. We'd like to get a focused technical deep-dive to cover integration constraints, network/firewall needs, and a brief walkthrough of the model routing options you mentioned.

Suggested goals:
- Surface any hard blockers for an on-prem/private deployment
- Walk our infra and networking team through expected ports, egress patterns, and KMS options
- Discuss fallbacks (lower-cost model variants) and latency targets for prioritized endpoints

People who should attend from our side: myself and Marta (network lead). From Redwood we'd like whoever will own the deployment orchestration + a solutions engineer.

Our availability (PDT):
- Thu Jul 1: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Fri Jul 2: 09:00–11:00

Can you propose a 60–75 minute slot and any pre-reads? Also please flag which internal Redwood attendees you plan to bring.

Thanks,
Sam
Samuel Ortiz
Director of Engineering | BlueArc Medical
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@bluearcmed.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@bluearcmed.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery — technical deep-dive request

Sam — great to hear, happy to set this up. Proposed plan: 75-minute session with a short 15-minute runbook handoff at the end. Agenda draft:
1) 10 min — goals and current infra recap
2) 25 min — network / security requirements (ports, IPs, proxy patterns)
3) 20 min — deployment options and routing/fallbacks (hosted vs. private; quantized model variants)
4) 10 min — Q&A and next steps
5) 10 min — follow-up runbook & action items

Suggested slots (PDT):
- Thu Jul 1, 14:00–15:15 — preferred (aligns with our SE schedule)
- Fri Jul 2, 09:30–10:45 — backup

Pre-reads attached: discovery-summary.pdf (notes from yesterday) and a short pre-read doc with the network checklist (pre-read-network-requirements.docx).

Bringing: Lauren Bishop (Solutions Architect) and Soojin Lee (Sales Engineer). If either of those times work, I'll send a calendar invite with a short meeting brief and the Zoom link. If you need an earlier slot on Thu morning we'll try to rearrange but 14:00 is best for the engineering crew.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — I can take the network/security portion. One note for Sam: can you confirm whether BlueArc uses a corporate proxy for outbound TLS termination and whether you have static egress IP requirements? That will alter a couple of our recommendations.

I'm fine to do Thu Jul 1, 14:00–15:15 PDT. Soojin, can you bring the demo environment checklist (env vars, certs, KMS options)?

Quick pre-read ask for BlueArc: if you can share any existing network diagrams (simple dot points are fine), that will help us tailor the session. If not, we'll run with the discovery notes.
